name: Monochrome
line: Gallery-like reduction in white, black and grey: a very large thin Noto Serif Display headline beside one Blossfeldt acanthus shown as a black-and-white print, which is revealed by a slow vertical mask while the headline words rise; later sections hold one idea each, with hairline scale bars for 100–120 vs 4–5 in 1,000 and the explorers set as two lines of thin numerals beside their network drawings in greyscale.
notes: Uses the short headline ('What causes cancer, and how sure is the evidence?') with 'cancer and other chronic diseases' in the line beneath. Grey #8A8A8A is only used for large numerals and the scale bars because it fails AA for small text; small secondary text is black at 64% (#626262, 6:1), still no other hue. The Blossfeldt scan, the network drawings and the game screenshots are desaturated with CSS filters (games regain colour on hover). Noto Serif Display and Geist cover Cyrillic; Chinese falls back to system fonts.
